visual_action: A montage of clips plays in the background behind a static, superimposed cutout of Donald Trump speaking. The background clips show an aerial view of a border patrol vehicle driving along a canal near a border, a person in handcuffs, and other people in handcuffs being escorted onto an airplane at night.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A cutout of Donald Trump is superimposed on the screen for the entire video, and his voice provides the only spoken audio.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump says, "Look, I hate to do it, but I will do it. I would give myself an A+."
audio_music: A loud, aggressive electronic track ('BUMM BASS MANIA' by DJ HARDCORE PURGE, DJ TOILET FUCKER) plays throughout the video underneath Donald Trump's spoken words, creating a jarring and intense atmosphere.
editing_pacing: A montage of short clips with a static superimposed image of a person speaking over them, a common meme format.
manipulation_or_satire: A cutout of Donald Trump's head and torso is superimposed at the bottom of the video, creating the false impression that he is speaking in front of a montage of border security and deportation scenes.
cultural_references: The video uses a common meme format where a static cutout of a person is superimposed over background footage.
central_claim: The post uses Donald Trump's own words to mock his self-proclaimed 'A+' performance on border security by pairing his quote with intense music and scenes of deportations.
intended_effect: To mock Donald Trump and portray his self-assessment on border policy as absurd and out of touch.
